title: How to apply: UK opens 2026 Commonwealth Fellowships for Nigerians

article.title: How to apply: UK opens 2026 Commonwealth Fellowships for Nigerians
article.summary: The United Kingdom has opened applications for the 2026/27 Commonwealth Fellowship Programme, offering Nigerian professionals and university academics an opportunity to undertake fully funded fellowships in the UK. Applications for the programme opened on July 28, 2026, and will close at 4:00 p.m. BST on August 25, 2026.
